title: Literal aligned boxes and explicit reference-energy renormalization
theory: A1 literal vertex boxes Lambda_N={0,...,N}^3, selected xy strips anchored (4i,2j,z), A2 omitted coefficients unchanged; select N=4m+3.

scale.c_N: sum of complete-strip ground energies, energy-origin subtraction not an added interaction

target: Prove literal aligned boxes contain only complete strip factors and free links. Derive exact omitted face weight W_N with orientation ranges xy x,y<N,z<=N; xz x,z<N,y<=N; yz y,z<N,x<=N. Define original unshifted H_box,N and c_N=sum_{C in box} E_C, and prove H_box,N-c_N plus the exact exterior reference generator is H_ref+V_box,N. Use D1/D2 on this literal family to obtain norm-resolvent/ground-state estimates.
acceptance: General all-m alignment/factor proof, not just fixtures
Exact face/strip count and dyadic tail checks N=3,7,11,15 plus at least one nonaligned boundary
Explicit scalar energy subtraction and proof it preserves states/gaps but not unshifted resolvents or absolute energies
All retained couplings unchanged and every orientation cutoff correct
Executed controls wrong all-three-anchor cube, nonaligned full-factor promotion, omit c_N, discard exterior generator, E_star=0
No arbitrary-phase convergence claim before E2
limits: Fixed spacing and summable coefficients; no homogeneous/continuum result
loop2_selection: Use E1 evidence to select or reject arbitrary-phase local-state convergence target.
